label: def:categorical-jet
title: Categorical jet object
html:
A jet object packages an element of A together with its infinitesimal variation. Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum universe over a commutative ring R with connection \nabla (categorical connection), and assume A is commutative, so that I = \ker(\mu \colon A \otimes A \to A) is an ideal of A \otimes A. The jet object is the first-jet module

  J^1(A) := (A \otimes A)/I^2 .

The section \ell(a) = [a \otimes 1] and the left inverse r \colon J^1(A) \to A induced by \mu satisfy r \circ \ell = \mathrm{id}_A, and \ker r = I/I^2, which is the module \Omega^1_{A/R} of Kähler differentials. The jet object therefore fits into the split extension

[Diagram]
LaTeX source
\begin{equation}\label{eq:jet-ses}
\begin{tikzcd}[column sep=2.5em]
  0 \ar[r]
  & \Omega^1_{A/R} \ar[r]
  & J^1(A) \ar[r, "j^1"]
  & A \ar[r]
  & 0
\end{tikzcd}
\end{equation}

where j^1 = r is the jet evaluation.
